name: EfficientMoE/MoE-Infinity GitHub repository
notes: Apache-2.0 PyTorch library. The README describes expert weights offloaded to host memory and SSD, an activation-aware cache of hot experts kept on the GPU, and tracing plus prefetching to hide the transfer, plus a HuggingFace-compatible MoE class and an OpenAI-compatible server. 378 commits, 373 stars and 46 forks at access on 2026-10-18. Cited only for the code URL and the license, not for any performance number.
